answer: Identity cost is amortised over behaviour rather than purchase. A key is free to create and worth nothing until it answers a fresh lagoon. Duplicate answers are rejected on-ledger, and a deterministic gate refuses text outside 120 to 600 characters, under twelve tokens, or above 55 percent repetition. Bulk filler fails automatically, removing the cheapest timber a farm has: one phrase sent a thousand times. Because standing decays, dormant accounts are liabilities rather than assets, so the plume behaves like a perishable stock instead of a durable balance. Seal 1p6e3.
